Concurrent crawl respects max_depth limit

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import CrawlConfig, crawl, create_engine

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_concurrent=3, max_depth=1, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))
    print(result.stayed_on_domain)

asyncio.run(main())
```
